name: get_inbound_count
description: Get the count of inbound shipments/deliveries at Fresh Factory for a given date and status. Use this when the user asks how many inbound shipments arrived, are pending, or match some status on a specific date.

date.description: The date to query, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

status.description: Inbound status to filter by (e.g. pending, received, completed). Exact valid values depend on the WMS and may need adjusting once connected to the real system.
